# Workspace Instructions

- Team Task Manager built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma, and PostgreSQL/MySQL.
- Use the shared contracts, validators, and UI primitives in `src/lib` and `src/components`.
- Keep API routes RESTful, validate all input with Zod, and enforce role-based authorization.
- Prefer server components for data loading and client components for interactive UI, forms, and drag-and-drop.
- Keep the UI dark, premium, and responsive.
